guidance: Derive fixture column types from the actual migration/schema and exercise the restricted native path with a rollback-only probe before declaring it live. Keep local, native and connected acceptance evidence distinct.
title: Match PostgreSQL fixtures to authoritative schema types
trigger: A scoped notification join passed fixtures with a TEXT aggregate id but native schema uses UUID; independent migration-shaped tests reproduced SQL42883.

guidance: Preserve authentication gates and historical uncertainty. Distinguish missing header, invalid scheme, unavailable configuration and rejected bearer using fixed nonsecret reasons and generated request IDs; never record credential values, hashes or lengths. Verify current browser transport separately from historical submissions.
title: Classify auth transport without attributing a generic401 to the owner
trigger: Secure browser submission returns a generic401 and historical request metadata is unavailable

guidance: Validate driver precedence including duplicate query options and inherited PG variables; canonicalize the fixed destination and startup options, encode credentials, and test with synthetic driver inputs before prompting for real credentials.
title: Validate the effective PostgreSQL driver target before operator credential entry
trigger: A URL authority guard precedes a pg connection using a connection string

guidance: Inspect actual scoped fixture eligibility and preserve tenant/provenance constraints. Use one exact unique existing identity with fail-closed association checks rather than assuming incidental trial registration; test zero-trial admission and wrong-scope rejection without creating business fixtures or changing grants.
title: Separate necessary synthetic scope checks from incidental fixture registration
trigger: An isolated acceptance helper rejects an existing enrolled synthetic startup goal only because no evaluation trial references it

guidance: Search every INSERT conflict target and report reader before applying the new key; execute the exact affected SQL against the migrated schema without invoking providers. Preserve prior immutable reports and application permissions.
title: Audit conflict targets when changing report uniqueness
trigger: Immutable report revisions replace an existing unique key
